Asset type: photoreal steel surface texture for an engineering image-measurement demonstration. This is a material asset that will be mapped onto an exactly defined L-shaped plate, not a finished measurement photograph.
Primary request: generate one square, high-resolution overhead photograph of the broad flat face of a real dark-gray mild steel scrap sheet. Steel fills the entire frame edge to edge; do not show its outer silhouette.
Materials/textures: naturally irregular fine diagonal scratches, light scuffs from workshop use, subtle mill scale, a few slightly brighter rub marks, honest photographic microtexture.
